name: comp-61
description: A textarea with a helper text paragraph below showing 'Please add as many details as you can'. Helper text is marked with aria-live and role='region'.
use_when: Forms where users need guidance on what to type in a field.
avoid_when: The helper text is temporary or contextual (use tooltips instead).
a11y: Label linked to textarea. Helper text is an aria-live region for announcements.
